hooks.text: 四个可解锁种族各自驾驶专属飞船，从矮人、人类、兽人到精灵形成不同开局
hooks.excerpt: Choose from four unlockable races, each with its ship: The fearless Dwarves , the intuitive Humans , the mystical Orks, or the glamorous Elves!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 连击可赚额外经验，清空敌人波次会回满电池，甚至能让回合持续不断
hooks.excerpt: Earn extra XP in combat by doing a chain of COMBOS! Plan and make your turns never end: Defeating a wave of enemies recharges your batteries. You might even resort to using your whole ship as a weapon!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 事件回应会生成不同Karma，同时改写角色声望与牌组走向
hooks.excerpt: Your response to events influences your reputation and deck: Karma will be generated during your interactions.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 美术风格受到明确肯定。
需要一段时间才会感到角色变强

excerpts.excerpt: it takes a while to feel like you're getting stronger.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 所有地图节点都能访问，使移动段落被过度拉长。

excerpts.excerpt: the fact that you can visit every node on the map really drags out the travel segments.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 战场单位偶尔会全部不显示。

excerpts.excerpt: 有时还会有战场上所有单位都不显示的bug
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 大量视觉效果会造成眼睛不适。

excerpts.excerpt: a lot of effects, I'm not epileptic, but even my eyes hurt.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: there aren’t many cards with explicit synergies
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 核心玩法循环容易上瘾。
卡牌种类和策略选项丰富。

excerpts.excerpt: Love the card variety and strategic options.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
